';
 }catch{toast('Capture is not supported in this browser')}}
function livingSaveObservation(){const t=`Living Scene / ${livingBeats[living.beat].title} · framing ${living.zoom}% · ${living.tone} light · ${living.sound} soundscape.\n${document.getElementById('livingLessonText').textContent}`;state.notes=(state.notes?state.notes+'\n\n':'')+t;document.getElementById('noteText').value=state.notes;save();toast('Observation saved to your private notebook')}
document.getElementById('trySceneBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>enter('scene'));
document.getElementById('jumpScene').addEventListener('click',()=>switchView('scene'));
document.getElementById('livingToEdit').addEventListener('click',()=>{
 editStop(true);
 const initial=living.zoom>66?'detail':living.zoom>35?'glance':'world';
 const i=editSequence.findIndex(x=>x.id===initial);
 if(i>0){const shot=editSequence.splice(i,1)[0];editSequence.unshift(shot)}
 editGrade=living.tone==='mono'?'mono':'color';editSoundMix=living.sound==='quiet'?0:living.sound==='field'?20:40;
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-grade]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.grade===editGrade));
 document.getElementById('editGradeValue').textContent=editGrade==='mono'?'MONOCHROME':'FILM COLOR';
 document.getElementById('editSoundSlider').value=editSoundMix;
 document.getElementById('editSoundValue').textContent=editSoundMix+'%';
 editRenderCards();editUpdateInsights();editDraw(0);
 switchView('edit');toast('Your framing, image treatment and sound atmosphere were carried into the cut');
});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-beat-pick],[data-scene-beat]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>livingUpdateBeat(b.dataset.beatPick??b.dataset.sceneBeat)));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-tone]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{living.tone=b.dataset.tone;livingPaint()}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-soundscape]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{livingSoundStop();living.sound=b.dataset.soundscape;livingPaint()}));
document.getElementById('livingDistance').addEventListener('input',e=>livingUpdateZoom(e.target.value));
document.getElementById('livingListen').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(living.playing)livingSoundStop();else livingSoundStart()});
document.getElementById('livingCapture').addEventListener('click',livingCapture);
document.getElementById('livingSaveNote').addEventListener('click',livingSaveObservation);
document.getElementById('livingReset').addEventListener('click',()=>{livingSoundStop();living.beat=0;living.zoom=24;living.tone='dusk';living.sound='quiet';livingPaint();toast('Living Scene reset')});
livingFrame.addEventListener('pointermove',livingParallax,{passive:true});livingFrame.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{livingFrame.style.setProperty('--parallax-x','0px');livingFrame.style.setProperty('--parallax-y','0px')});
livingFrame.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target!==livingFrame)return;if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){livingUpdateBeat(living.beat+1);e.preventDefault()}else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){livingUpdateBeat(living.beat-1);e.preventDefault()}});
let livingTouchX=null;livingFrame.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('button'))livingTouchX=e.touches[0].clientX},{passive:true});livingFrame.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{if(livingTouchX===null)return;const delta=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-livingTouchX;livingTouchX=null;if(Math.abs(delta)>65)livingUpdateBeat(living.beat+(delta<0?1:-1))},{passive:true});
const oldV5SwitchView=switchView;switchView=function(id){if(state.view==='scene'&&id!=='scene'){livingSoundStop();livingStopDrawing()}oldV5SwitchView(id);if(id==='scene'){document.getElementById('headerSubtitle').textContent='A LIVING SCENE · A FIRST DISCOVERY';livingPaint();livingStartDrawing()}};
const oldV5Portal=portal;portal=function(){livingSoundStop();livingStopDrawing();oldV5Portal()};
const oldV5ToggleMotion=toggleMotion;toggleMotion=function(){oldV5ToggleMotion();if(state.view==='scene'){if(state.motion)livingStartDrawing();else livingStopDrawing()}};
document.getElementById('motionBtn').onclick=toggleMotion;
window.addEventListener('pagehide',livingSoundStop);
livingPaint();
